commits.message:
chore: drop the orphaned .claude/skills/next copy (#112)

lit no longer writes this file. The mechanism that wrote
.claude/skills/next/SKILL.md into every repo lit was set up in was removed in
links-issue-tracker#493; the skill now ships from the links Claude Code plugin
(install once, available everywhere) rather than being copied into each
project tree. This is the leftover output of that removed generator: nothing
writes it, refreshes it, or references it, and while it stayed tracked here it
shadowed the plugin copy for any agent working in this repo.
